label: SystemWorkModeConfig
info:
System Work Mode Config - Read & Write

Registers:
- 243: Work mode (0=battery first, 1=load first)
- 244: Zero export limit power
- 245: Max sell power
- 247: Solar sell enable
- 248: TOU enable + days (bit field)
- 250-255: TOU time points 1-6
- 256-261: TOU power 1-6
- 262-267: TOU voltage 1-6
- 268-273: TOU capacity 1-6
- 274-279: TOU charge enable 1-6 (bit field)
- 280: Bit8-11 Grid peak shaving
- 293: Grid peak shaving power
- 416: Force off-grid
